accepted_scope: static camera intrinsics for the recorded image geometry only
review: Residual distributions and coverage plots visually reviewed; numerical gates pass; radial mapping does not fold inside image.
limits: Flat screen and preserved target aspect ratio assumed from displayed target; metric scale unmeasured.
Formal focal standard deviations describe this fitting model, not all systematic errors.
Few far-corner observations, especially bottom left; assess against independent Kalibr result when available.
Small static motion selected independently from reprojection residuals; moving rolling-shutter distortion is not calibrated by this model.
Invalid after focus, image geometry or optical assembly changes. Camera-to-IMU mounting/time/noise calibration remains absent.
